guide: Open Start and type your center name and your own limits in the yellow cells: staff on the Infants room, break minutes, on-costs, staff cost target, training hours and the weekly hours cap.
Check Rooms and Pay Rates. The ratio is the number of children each staff member may care for in a room: set it from your local rules, they are not a standard.
Keep Team up to date: one row per staff member and outside contact with contract hours and the room each teacher leads.
Enter shifts on Shifts: date, staff member, room, start, end, break and rate. Paid hours, wages and on-costs calculate by themselves.
Type the children counted and the staff present each hour on Ratio by Hour. Staff needed, the gap and the short or covered check fill in; Short Hours by Week and Cover Heat Map follow.
Plan next week on Rota Next Week, then read Break Plan: it shows every break that would leave a room below its ratio and a better time.
Log cover requests on Cover Requests and every relief or break-cover shift on Relief and Cover Shifts.
Enter payroll rows and check them against the shifts with the Pay-run Check; turnover and staff cost share by month sit on Turnover by Month.
Keep Renewals and Training current: status and dates only. The register shows what is due in 30, 45 and 60 days.

Use the 18 calculators for ratio, cover, breaks, cost per child-hour, relief, turnover, renewals, rota, overtime, swaps, floaters, management cover, cost share, training, hiring, pay and contract hours.
Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Staff and Ratio Dashboard and Charts every week. A single home daycare provider can use the same sheets with one room and one helper.

listing.title: Childcare Center Staff, Rota and Ratio Excel Template: Ratio by Hour, Cover Heat Map, Break Planner, Cost per Child-Hour, Relief Test
listing.headline: Know every hour your rooms are covered and what each staff hour costs
listing.description:
Run the people side of a home daycare or childcare center in one Excel workbook. Built for an owner-director with 1 to 5 rooms and up to a dozen staff. Ratio means the number of children each staff member may care for in a room: you set it per room from your local rules. Ratio by Hour turns the children counted each hour into staff needed, staff present and the gap, so you see the exact room-hours that were short.

Short Hours by Week and a Cover Heat Map rank rooms and weeks for relief. Rota Next Week feeds a Break Plan that checks every break against the staff each room needs and suggests a better time. Cost per Child-Hour compares rooms month by month, Turnover by Month adds staff cost share against your own target, and Renewals and Training keep status and dates only, with 30, 45 and 60 day bands.

18 calculators answer the weekly questions: is the room covered, where do relief hours go, do breaks clash, which room costs most, hire relief or hold, does a raise pay back, who is over the hours cap, is a swap safe and where does a floater help most. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to staff, floaters, teachers, the owner-director, the accountant, the cook and the cleaner. Children's data is counts and dates only.

This is part three of the Home Daycare and Childcare Center suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. It helps you keep track of staffing and does not promise results.

competitors.lacks: record who was there but never compare children with staff each hour, so a short hour is invisible
list shifts but do not check breaks against the ratio, cost per child-hour or hours over contract
charge every month or per child and keep ratio and staff cost logic hidden, so you cannot see why a room is short
total pay but never tie it to the shifts, the rooms or the relief and cover cost
hold dates but give no 30, 45 and 60 day bands, no training hours against a target and no cost per person
